_documentation.weights: Equal weights encode no validated preference; they are a maximum-entropy neutral prior and remain heuristic. Replace only with experimentally validated weights.
_documentation.dependencyGroups: AST/CFG/DFG/taint collapse into one program_analysis group; model prediction/SAE/interactions collapse into one model_internal group.
_documentation.missingPolicy: renormalize excludes unavailable Eq. (28) components and renormalizes remaining weights; 'unavailable' refuses to score when any component is missing.
_documentation.cweProfiles: Empty by design: no CWE receives an implicit severity. Supply normalized profiles with an explicit basis from a documented source.
